maddeler.e:
ينصهر (form VII)
# يَنْصَهِرُ (yanṣahiru) /jan.sˤa.hi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْصَهَرَ (inṣahara)
# يَنْصَهِرَ (yanṣahira) /jan.sˤa.hi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْصَهَرَ (inṣahara)
# يَنْصَهِرْ (yanṣahir) /jan.sˤa.hir/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْصَهَرَ (inṣahara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
